scientific_limitations: Unweighted canonical Haar-pushforward hexablock Hardy space only; this is an explicit basis for the x_3 coordinate isometry, not all multipliers or all hexablock isometries. A differently parametrized earlier formula has not been categorically excluded.
title: Jacobi-polynomial wandering basis for the canonical hexablock Hardy shift
